/-!
# Erdős Problem 268

*Reference:*
 - [erdosproblems.com/268](https://www.erdosproblems.com/268)
 - [KoTa24] Kova\vC, V. and Tao T., On several irrationality problems for Ahmes series.
-/

namespace Erdos268

/-- Let `X` be the set of points in `Fin d → ℝ` of the shape
`fun i : Fin d => ∑' n : A, (1 : ℝ) / (n + i)` for some infinite subset `A ⊆ ℕ` such that
`1 / n` is summable over `A`. `X` has nonempty interior. This is proved in [KoTa24].
--/
@[category research solved, AMS 40 54, formal_proof using lean4 at
  "https://gist.githubusercontent.com/madeve-unipi/62a8f68cdb4864b85b81a6752dcb0aa4/raw/5793aaa51089c25c37d8d63f60540367f6abe506/Erdos268.lean"]
theorem erdos_268 (d : ℕ) : (interior {x : Fin d → ℝ | ∃ A : Set ℕ, A.Infinite ∧
    Summable (fun n : A => (1 : ℝ) / n ) ∧
    x = fun i : Fin d => ∑' n : A, (1 : ℝ) / (n + i)}).Nonempty := by
  sorry

end Erdos268

status_issues.recorded: The theorem for arbitrary d : ℕ carries a `formal_proof using lean4` annotation pointing to the linked gist.
status_issues.source_status: The cited formal certificate establishes the three-dimensional case only. The general all-dimensional result is correctly recorded as research solved, following Kovač–Tao, but this link does not certify the full generality of the attached declaration.
status_issues.evidence: In the exact linked revision, lines 36–39 define `harmonicSubseriesSet : Set (Fin 3 → ℝ)`, and lines 1292–1296 conclude `harmonicSubseriesSet_interior_nonempty : (interior harmonicSubseriesSet).Nonempty`. There is no corresponding arbitrary-dimensional conclusion. The source page separately credits Kovač with the three-dimensional solution and Kovač–Tao with the higher-dimensional extension; the latter is Corollary 1.10 of arXiv:2406.17593v4.
status_issues.suggested_change: Keep `category research solved` on the general theorem, but move this `formal_proof` annotation to a d = 3 specialization, or replace the link with a formal proof covering every dimension.

reformulations.difference: Lean allows both d = 0 and 0 ∈ A; Kovač–Tao use positive dimensions and sets of positive integers. Although allowing zero can change the represented set, the universally quantified nonempty-interior statements are equivalent.
reformulations.equivalence_argument: Write L_d for the Lean set and P_d for the positive-integer set. Certainly P_d ⊆ L_d. Conversely, project L_(d+1) onto coordinates 1,…,d. A point represented by A projects to the point represented by B = {n+1 : n ∈ A} in P_d. The set B is positive and infinite, and its reciprocal series converges by comparison with the reciprocal series over A, apart from the single possible n = 0 term. Coordinate projection is an open map, so nonempty interior of L_(d+1) implies nonempty interior of P_d. This proves the reverse implication between the all-dimensional statements. The extra zero-dimensional case holds because A = {2^k : k ∈ ℕ} is infinite and summable, making the represented set the entire one-point space. This full equivalence was proved as Review268.full_equivalence in /workspace/review/scratch.lean, with no sorry-dependent axioms.

review.notes: The sole mathematical declaration is faithful to Kovač–Tao's Corollary 1.10. The scratch file compiles successfully and also proves `shifted_summable`, confirming that every coordinate series converges even when zero belongs to A; thus no coordinate uses tsum's nonsummable fallback. Both this lemma and the full equivalence depend only on propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. The linked gist has no explicit sorry or custom axiom, but does not compile unchanged against the supplied Mathlib; those compatibility errors are not being reported as an additional mathematical defect or as invalidating its three-dimensional proof. The reviewed file's hash matches the committed file.
